'''Ghibli fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was edible by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Patterns" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion [[I-5YQ]] provided a plate of the fruit to a young Human [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] named [[Kajin Savaros]], after Pavan brought Savaros to his [[Poloda Place]] apartment on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Savaros ate the fruit while Pavan questioned him about his [[The Force/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and his [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|encounters]] with the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], a group of Force-users who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Patterns" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghibli fruit first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]]<ref name="Patterns" /> with help from [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]].<ref name="Bohnhoff">{{WebCite|url=http://paperdragonink.com/?p=1817|text=Interview with Author Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff >> Paper Dragon ink|author=Lentes, Douglas|date=2012-01-15, 9:39 pm|work=Paper Dragon ink|archivedate=20120120015419}}</ref>
